title: THE STUDIES OF THE ACTIVATED COMPOUND (I) A METAL INDUCED ACYLATION
abstract: Abstract                The new activated compound, 2-acyloxy-3-methylpyrazine was treated with the Grignard reagent to give ketone in high yield. The comparison of reactivity of the activated compounds (8-acyloxyquinoline and 2-acyloxy-3-methylpyrazine) was described.
